test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sparse_column_index_runs_{run_length} ( id UInt64, u64 UInt64, payload String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0.8
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sparse_column_index_runs_{run_length} SELECT number, number % 20 = 0 ? number : 0, number % 20 = 0 ? repeat(toString(number), 64) : '' FROM numbers(intDiv(1000000, {run_length}))
test.query: SELECT u64, payload FROM (SELECT u64, payload FROM sparse_column_index_runs_{run_length}) ARRAY JOIN range({run_length}) AS element FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_lazy_columns_replication = 1
